description.zh:
实例ID集合 ，用半角逗号（,）分割：
- 实例可以不属于任何集群，但一个实例最多只能归属于一个集群。
- ECS实例和目标集群需在同一个VPC内。
description.en:
The IDs of the ECS instances. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,).

- The instances must be in the same VPC as the target cluster.

- An instance can belong to only one cluster at a time.

description.zh: 加入目标集群的实例需要设置的登录密码。
description.en: The logon password to set for the instances.
The ID of the target cluster.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制说明
调用该接口导入ECS实例时，会重装ECS实例的操作系统，重装后，实例中所有数据都会被删除并且需要重新设置实例登录密码。请确保您要导入的ECS实例上没有重要的数据或数据已备份。
descriptions.en:
## Limitations

Calling this API to import an ECS instance reinstalls its operating system. This process deletes all data on the instance and requires you to reset the logon password. Before you import the instance, back up any important data.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas transform-cluster-member --instance-ids i-2ze7s2v0b789k60p0000 --target-cluster-id b3e3f77b-462e-0000-0000-bec8727a0000 --password Hello0000 --region cn-hangzhou
